steps.title: Initialize Project & Dependencies
steps.description: Configure metadata, app structure, Tailwind CSS browser runtime, and core CSS layout styling.

steps.title: Define Backend API Schema
steps.description: Create schema with video projects collection, user roles, endpoints, and video duration logic.

steps.title: Implement Cloud Authentication Client
steps.description: Develop client for login, register, automatic login chaining, and Gmail OTP password reset.

steps.title: Implement Generic Backend Data CRUD Client
steps.description: Build standardized generic /data API handlers for creating, reading, updating, and deleting video projects.

steps.title: Construct Studio Layout & Navigation Bar
steps.description: Design responsive navigation with project name input, account status, export trigger, and view toggles.

steps.title: Build AI Prompt & Storyboard Generator Panel
steps.description: Create creative prompt input, style presets, duration selectors, aspect ratios, and AI prompt presets.

steps.title: Develop Interactive Canvas Video Engine
steps.description: Engineer HTML5 Canvas rendering pipeline supporting Ken Burns camera pan, zoom, dynamic transitions, and captions.

steps.title: Synthesize AI Voiceover & Web Audio Studio
steps.description: Implement browser SpeechSynthesis narration synced to scene timings alongside procedural cinematic ambient music.

steps.title: Construct Interactive Timeline & Scene Tracks
steps.description: Create multi-track timeline showing scene blocks, audio waveform visualization, playhead scrubbing, and reordering.

steps.title: Build Scene Inspector & Customization Controls
steps.description: Develop fine-grained scene settings for visuals, text overlays, animations, transitions, and narration script.

steps.title: Implement Real-Time Video Recording & Export Engine
steps.description: Use MediaRecorder and Canvas captureStream with combined audio tracks to export playable WebM/MP4 videos.

steps.title: Build Projects Manager & Cloud Sync Modal
steps.description: Develop modal to list saved cloud projects, load drafts, duplicate, and delete project records.

steps.title: Implement Offline Calculations & Metadata Analytics
steps.description: Perform client-side calculation of total duration, words per minute, audio buffer lengths, and file size estimates.

steps.title: Building videomakerai
steps.description: Finalize integrated verification, UI transitions, responsive checks, and system testing.
